verdict.rationale: dLocal documents accepting local payment methods through one platform, with dedicated wallet-payment flows (enrollment IDs for direct charges) and local methods like Pix alongside cards, all in the same API. However, the evidence never names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL. Missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay support, documented bank-redirect methods, BNPL options, and independent corroboration of single-integration coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Accept and disburse the local payment methods and currencies billions of consumers prefer — all through one platform.
dLocal returns an enrollment ID used for all subsequent direct charges. No redirect or re-authentication required.
The user can complete the payment using any Home Banking or Ewallet App, by copying and pasting a Transaction ID or scanning a QR code
